title: North Carolina court revives roofing firm's lawsuits against insurers over unpaid storm repairs
summary_full: A North Carolina appeals court has reinstated lawsuits from Piedmont Roofing Services against various major insurance companies. Overturning an earlier trial judge's dismissal of breach of contract claims, the court concluded that sufficient grounds exist for the roofing company to pursue its claims. This ruling sheds light on the intricate legal issues related to the transfer of insurance rights in property damage situations.
